about_the_game:
Discover The Mountain of Wishes, a crumbling mountain where only the strongest can reach the top.

Once you reach the top, the Mountain will grant you your most cherished wish. Find out what this bald man's wish is.

Here you will find other people seeking the same purpose in life; some will find what they wanted, others simply got lost.

You control a directionless man who left everything behind to climb it and find his life's purpose.

Be careful! Every step is precise, keep your balance like a drunk and rethink your steps.

Climbing can be a challenge if you are not careful and patient!

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: 10th Gen Core i3/ Ryzen 3
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: GTX 1050 or better
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 4 GB available space
  • Additional Notes: It is recommended to play above 45 fps
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: 10th Gen Core i5/ Ryzen 5
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: GTX 1660 or better
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 5 GB available space
  • Additional Notes: It is recommended to play above 45 fps

short_description: I know, another climbing game that nobody asked for, but this time, you'll control a drunk bald man who wants to find his purpose in life. Climb the ''Mountain of Wishes'', always taking one step at a time.
